## dependency_form
- Prerequisite sentence verbatim on the blocked side (12476623) only. PASS on the edge.
- Titles are general subjects. 12476623 "A Family's Own Cancellation of a Courtesy Rider Permit" is the on_request type of B.
- Computation documents 43540200 and bcceb47f carry no hint of a variation (scan for unless / may apply / elsewhere / certain / set out / exception: none).
- **KB-01 (KB-EXPLICIT RED)** — adjustment_waiver_share_by_meal_status_adaa36fc, the paragraph after the tier table: "The tier is the one the meal account holds on the day the adjustment is figured, not the tier it held when the permit fee posted." The rule only says the share "is read from the student's School Nutrition meal account on the day the adjustment is figured". The added clause names the alternative reading (the tier at posting) as the one not to take. That is a contrast between a wrong and a correct reading inside a factor document, and it lands on exactly the distinction this task's world turns on: Paid, so no credit, at the 2026-09-04 posting; Free (HA) from 2026-10-01. The semantics are correct and the solution is unchanged. The issue is only the form of the statement.
- Verdict: **KB-EXPLICIT RED (KB-01)**.
